product.statement: CarePath Tokyo turns a natural-language public-health or support need plus a Tokyo location into grounded, actionable public-resource options without requiring a health-data upload or account.
product.problem_statement: Tokyo has authoritative public-health and support resources, but people may not know the formal service name, may face language barriers, or may struggle to judge which nearby resource is relevant. CarePath Tokyo provides a bounded multilingual navigation layer while keeping resource facts traceable to official data.

actions.rule: Show only when a verified address or coordinate is available.
Show only when a phone number is present in the source data.
Always expose an official source or catalogue link from provenance.

primary_scenarios.title: Find nearby healthcare with explicit English support

interactions.request: I need a nearby clinic in Tokyo where staff can support me in English.
東京で、英語で対応してもらえる近くの診療所を探したいです。
我想在东京找一家附近可以用英语沟通的诊所。

expected.outcome: Return nearby healthcare resources only when English support is explicitly reported by the authoritative source. If none match, return a structured no-match result instead of silently dropping the language requirement.

primary_scenarios.title: Find a nearby designated cooling shelter

interactions.request: It is extremely hot. I need a nearby designated place where I can cool down.
とても暑いので、近くの指定クーリングシェルターを探したいです。
天气非常热，我想找一个附近的指定避暑场所。

expected.outcome: After the safety gate, return nearby designated cooling shelters. Never claim live opening, capacity or availability unless a future authoritative source explicitly provides it.

primary_scenarios.title: Navigate to family support without knowing the service name

interactions.request: I am overwhelmed with childcare and do not know which Tokyo public service I should contact for family support.
育児で困っていますが、どの公的な相談先に連絡すればよいのか分かりません。
我在育儿方面遇到困难，但不知道应该联系东京的哪种公共支持服务。

expected.outcome: Map ordinary natural language to the family_support category without requiring the user to know the formal service name, while keeping every resource fact source-bounded.

failure_scenarios.trigger: Browser geolocation is denied or unavailable.
failure_scenarios.expected_behavior: Preserve the natural-language request and immediately offer a manual Tokyo location fallback. Do not require account creation, profile creation or health-data upload.

failure_scenarios.trigger: No resource satisfies all hard constraints within the bounded search.
failure_scenarios.expected_behavior: Return a structured empty state that names the unmet constraint and offers bounded adjustments. Never invent a resource or silently weaken a required constraint.

failure_scenarios.trigger: A matched resource lacks language, opening, access, phone or coordinate data.
failure_scenarios.expected_behavior: Keep unknown fields explicit, hide actions that lack verified inputs, and never turn missing data into positive evidence.

failure_scenarios.trigger: The language model or structured-intent provider is unavailable or invalid.
failure_scenarios.expected_behavior: Preserve the request and location, use a bounded deterministic/category fallback when possible, omit unsupported generated explanation, and keep verified resource facts usable.

failure_scenarios.trigger: The request contains urgent red flags, for example fainting, confusion or inability to stay awake during severe heat.
failure_scenarios.expected_behavior: Run deterministic safety handling before ordinary navigation, present urgent escalation guidance in the selected interface language, and never let an ordinary resource card substitute for the safety response.
